latin: Sicut et uidetur et auditur homo ab homine per motionem sensus ad extra, ita et uidetur et auditur demon ab homine et a demone per motionem sensus ad intra.
translation: Just as a man is seen and heard by a man through a motion of sense directed outward, so too a demon is seen and heard by a man, and by another demon, through a motion of sense directed inward.
translation_note: 'motionem sensus ad extra/ad intra' is rendered literally as sense-motion outward and inward, at farmer1998:22887.
